There are no signs of obfuscated code, unexpected file operations, or execution of external scripts. The package follows secure and reproducible build practices, including dependency freezing and checksum verification. While the package installs documentation (including `hyprland.conf`) to `/usr/share/doc`, this is standard and poses no risk.
